memories_after: [Fact] (ticket:AGN-2 {"project":"docs"}) The docs project has no local pre-merge command configured in agenium.toml; failing pre-merge rules surface only in the merge-failure message.

[Lesson] (ticket:AGN-2 {"project":"docs"}) Checking only the ticket's acceptance criteria is not enough in the docs project; the pre-merge check enforces additional project rules that must be satisfied before submit_report.

[Fact] (ticket:AGN-1 {"project":"docs"}) When adding a file to deliverables/ or reports/ in the docs project, put 'Owner: docs-team' as the exact first line before submitting; otherwise the pre-merge check fails and the work is reopened.

[Fact] (ticket:AGN-1 {"project":"docs"}) In the docs project, every team document placed in deliverables/ or reports/ must have 'Owner: <team-name>' as its exact first line (project rule); for the docs-team, this is exactly 'Owner: docs-team'.
[Fact] (ticket:AGN-1 {"os":"windows","project":"docs"}) The docs project tickets are worked on Windows using PowerShell; file contents are verified with Get-Content -LiteralPath <file> -Raw.
